description: Why: StagingConfig.drain_workers is documented to control the number of concurrent drain tasks pulling articles from the staging store into the ingestion queue. What: main.rs always spawns exactly one drain task regardless of the drain_workers value. High-throughput deployments that set drain_workers > 1 in their config will see no scaling benefit. The field is silently ignored after parsing.
title: drain_workers config field ignored; always 1 drain task
